# fractional

Local copy of the MIT-licensed library by Erik Garrison.

Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ekg/fraction.js/master/index.js

Retrieved on 2026-11-15. The copyright and license are included in index.js.
Installed through a local npm dependency because the development environment
could not reach the npm registry. Included in the repository so npm ci can
reproduce the build without downloading this dependency.
